name: Earl Grey
personality: Earl Grey is a dignified gentleman who enjoys window watching and chin scratches on his own terms. He is calm, independent and perfect for a quiet home.

name: Mochi
personality: Mochi is a curious kitten who turns everything into a toy. After a burst of play she loves to curl up in a lap and purr. She would love a home with another playful young cat.

name: Hazel
personality: Hazel is a sweet, slightly shy girl who blossoms once she trusts you. She enjoys long sniffy walks and quiet evenings. She would prefer to be the only pet in the home.

name: Rocket
personality: Rocket is a big-pawed puppy with endless energy. He is learning basic commands and picks things up fast. Best for an active home with a yard and patience for puppy training.

name: Maple
personality: Maple is a gentle senior who has seen it all and just wants a soft bed and someone to lean on. She is house-trained, calm on leash and gets along with everyone she meets.

name: Biscuit
personality: Biscuit is a cheerful little guy who greets everyone with a wagging tail. He loves short walks, squeaky toys and naps in sunny spots. He would do well in an apartment with a family who has time to play.
